correctness.rationale: Every nilpotent arrow lies in the radical and all nonradical diagonal elements are nonnilpotent. Every unital hom induces one of four diagonal quotient maps; the idempotent lift and Peirce space yield exhaustive P/R/S families. The P square conditions L^2=L,Lu=0 count kernel shears and complementary idempotents exactly. Automorphisms cannot swap the unequal Peirce dimensions and conjugate each idempotent L by rank. The independently enumerated small-field basis-map cases in checker.py confirm the formulas; no infinite claim rests on enumeration.
